faq_q1: Does this work for any destination?
faq_a1: Yes — CompanionAway works for any international relocation, whether from Europe to the US, within Europe, or further afield. I have deepest expertise in European to US moves and European to European moves. If you're relocating somewhere less common, reach out before purchasing and I'll tell you honestly whether I can build you something truly useful.
faq_q2: How long does it take to receive my guide?
faq_a2: Once I receive your signed agreement and payment, I'll send a confirmation email and get started. You'll get a notification the moment your guide is live on the platform: Settler plan guides arrive within 7–10 business days, Roots plan guides within 5–7 business days (priority).
faq_q3: What if my situation changes after I receive my guide?
faq_a3: That's exactly what revision rounds are for. Both plans include 2 revision rounds — if your arrival date changes, your housing situation shifts, or something new comes up, just let me know and I'll update your guide. Additional revisions are available at $19 each.
faq_q4: What's the difference between Settler and Roots?
faq_a4: The guide itself is the same quality and depth. The difference is support depth and duration: Settler includes 14 days of offline support with replies within 72 hours on business days, 1 revision round, and 3-month platform access. Roots includes 90 days of priority support with replies within 48 hours on business days, 2 revision rounds, 12-month platform access, and monthly check-ins for the first 3 months. If you expect a lot of questions along the way, Roots is worth it.
faq_a5: You can message me directly through the platform with any questions — on business days, excluding weekends and public holidays. No scheduling, no time zone stress. You ask when it suits you, I answer within 72h (Settler) or 48h (Roots). Think of it as having someone knowledgeable available, without the formality of a booked appointment.
faq_a6: If you request a refund before I begin work on your guide, a full refund will be issued. Once you receive a confirmation that work has started, refunds are not available — but I'll always apply a revision round first if something isn't right. Not sure? Browse the free sample guide before purchasing.
